### 💡 Proposed Feature or Level Concept

### 🕹️ How It Enhances Gameplay
Explain how this mechanic challenges the player or adds to the classic Nokia Bounce nostalgia.

### 📐 Mockups / References
Add sketches, GIFs, or references from original Nokia Bounce or modern 3D physics platformers.
